ledger.claim: Strategy distribution formulation; entropy/value tradeoff; policy-identification motivation
ledger.method: Full text, definitions, quantifiers and assumption mapping
ledger.result: Appendix theorem requires discrete policy set, candidate access, bounded independent returns; paper explicitly disclaims guarantee for actual neural implementation.

ledger.method: Analytic proof audit including heavy atoms, monotonicity and tau=1
ledger.result: Bound with +2 valid; do not conflate main abbreviated asymptotic expression with missing-heavy-atom proof.

ledger.method: Hoeffding constants, union bound, truncation, epsilon dependencies
ledger.result: Mean-error tolerances and3vmin/2 result consistent within stated assumptions.

ledger.claim: Narrower child supports imply lower entropy by construction
ledger.method: Complete finiteMDP/conditionaldistribution counterexample and independent arithmetic

ledger.location: p18 B.2; released tree.py and stored tree JSON
ledger.method: Static recursive dataflow, independent JSON arithmetic on5trees
ledger.result: One actual supplied tree changes argmax; controls and historical limits retained.

ledger.location: pp18-24 B.1-B.3; strategy prompts and code
ledger.method: Read prompts/aggregation/termination and compare formal meanings
ledger.result: LLM metrics and plan formulas are heuristic; no entropy computation. Related unresolved historical ranking stages documented.

ledger.location: p5 Section4.4; pp25-26 B.4-B.7; reward_shaper_text_score.py, custom_ppo.py, configs
ledger.claim: Distilled strategy score and annealed reward mixture
ledger.method: Full static reward-code read; check score normalization, data sources, mixup, training defaults and direct mixture
ledger.result: Direct scaled mixture matches appendix; main next-state/current-state distinction and exact configurations matter. No invariance guarantee asserted; no trained reward network verified.

ledger.location: rl_agent.py evaluation callback; custom_ppo.py rollout call order
ledger.claim: PPO periodic evaluation preserves training trajectory semantics
ledger.method: Static object alias/call-order analysis; independent transition fixture

ledger.claim: Crafter speedups, behavioral specialization, baselines and empirical strategy metrics
ledger.method: Read all experimental text/tables and figure captions; manually cross-check Tables1/5,2/8, easy hunting milestones, medium rank products
ledger.result: Medium and behavior evidence supported as reported; easy baseline faster on hunting threshold; raw runs/statistical construction and total interaction costs not reproduced.

ledger.claim: Related-work distinctions, cognitive motivation, hospital illustration
ledger.result: Normative/illustrative extrapolations not treated as clinical evidence; no exhaustive cited-paper verification or novelty survey performed.

ledger.claim: Limits of estimates, implementation, scaling and real-world applicability
ledger.method: Read complete limitations and compare with report impacts
ledger.result: Preserves acknowledged heuristic calibration, low-level realization and deployment limitations.
